$comment: Canonical brand-string mapping for the trademark/regression guard (scripts/check-banned-brand-strings.ts). This file moved from scripts/ to audit/ in Task #3255 (codename rollout) so the canonical mapping lives next to the rest of the audit artifacts. Source of truth: ORIGINALITY_REPORT.md rename map. The check direction is: BAN the OLD pre-rename codenames, REPLACE with the canonical post-rename brand names. Counsel-related entries are intentionally preserved as-is per Task #3255 hard constraint #1.
$bannedStringsComment: Each entry matches case-sensitively with strict boundaries (no adjacency to word chars, hyphens, underscores, slashes, colons). To catch a brand in multiple casings, add separate entries for `Pascal` and `UPPER` variants. The audit intentionally preserved lowercase URL slugs (e.g. /aegis/) so do NOT add lowercase variants. Optional fields: `risk: true` flags a term that is banned because of an unresolved trademark/availability concern (the check still surfaces these as violations; the flag exists so reviewers see the risk without re-running the trademark analysis). `notes` is a one-line human note attached to risk entries.

bannedStrings.notes: Do not redo the trademark analysis (Task #3255 constraint #2). Treat the prior outcome as final until brand counsel re-clears the term. See ORIGINALITY_REPORT.md and audit/brand-historical-references.md for context.

$fileAllowlistComment: Whole-file exemptions. Use sparingly; prefer lineAllowlist. Globs are not supported — list explicit paths relative to repo root, or directory prefixes ending with '/'.
$lineAllowlistComment: Per-line exemptions. Each entry: { file, line, term, reason }. The check matches by exact file path + line number + matched term.
